method: Publisher ZIPs downloaded in GitHub Actions to temporary storage; SWORD entries read through diatheke -f internal with query key last, hard 4MiB output limit. USFM source counted separately. No text copied into this file.
limits: These are diatheke internal rendering signals, not validated original authoring OSIS XML or full-document structural guarantees.
LSG published USFM and compiled SWORD may be different revisions; full text and note correspondence not yet established.
MHC has no verified original full OSIS authoring file in this test; full-source diff is not possible from these binary samples alone.
No paragraph or stanza transformation of either real module has been proposed, applied, validated in Bible GTK or published.
Prior preliminary runs erroneously emitted whole-module data due flag order; their results are invalid, superseded by this bounded query evidence.
Do not infer whether John 5:4 or Acts 8:37 are present/empty from raw output byte count.
